hero.title: Skandagupta: The Last Great Gupta
hero.description: Skandagupta, the savior of the Gupta Empire, successfully repelled the Huna invasions and maintained the integrity of the realm during the 5th century CE.

items.title: B.J.P (Skandagupta's Pillars)
items.decryption: Remember that while Prayag belongs to Samudragupta, Bhitari and Junagadh are the primary sources for Skandagupta's military achievements.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing Skandagupta's title 'Vikramaditya' with Chandragupta II.
Assuming the decline of the Gupta empire ended immediately after Skandagupta; he actually maintained stability for a long period.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Core: Magadha and Ayodhya
  • Strategic focus: Northwest borders (Huna threat)
  • Junagadh (Girnar) control

Personalities

  • Parnadatta: Governor of Saurashtra
  • Chakrapalita: Son of Parnadatta
  • Huna Tribes: The existential external threat

Empire Strategy Flow

  • Administrative Reforms:
    • Division of empire into Bhuktis and Vishayas.
    • Emphasis on local autonomy in Saurashtra (Junagadh inscription).
  • Military Might:
    • Defeated the Hunas as confirmed by the Bhitari Pillar Inscription.
    • Rebuilt the Sudarshana Lake dam.
